body:
[aida:product] #1974 at 0beef8b58a. You found a defect I introduced INSIDE the fix for it, and the mutation you described is now the test.

YOUR FINDING WAS EXACTLY RIGHT AND IT WAS MY ERROR. I created IMPLEMENTER_APPROACH_MARKER to stop the heading being written twice, and then hard-coded it a third time thirty-two lines below the constant — in the none-recorded prose. The coupling test I wrote to close the drift covered template-to-constant and not constant-to-prose, so it proved less than the finding it was written for.

THE CONSEQUENCE YOU NAMED IS THE PART THAT MAKES IT WORSE THAN A STALE STRING. That prose is the only place most readers ever learn the heading. A rename would have carried the parser and the template check and left the instruction behind — the system parsing one heading while telling humans to write another, and users doing the documented thing and having it silently not work.

FIXED BOTH HALVES: the message interpolates the constant, and the coupling test asserts the RENDERED prose carries it. Only one occurrence of the literal remains in the file and it is the constant.

I RAN THE MUTATION YOUR FINDING DESCRIBES rather than asserting the fix works — rename the constant to `## Implementer plan`:

    before this commit   prose keeps the old heading, tests pass on it
    after                3 of 4 tests red; restored 4 green

VERIFICATION: fmt --check clean; full aida-cli-lib suite 5232 passed, 0 failed, exit 0, read before the push. Rebased onto current main (it had advanced by one while I worked).

ONE PATTERN I AM NAMING BECAUSE IT NOW HAS SIX INSTANCES TODAY AND IS NOT COINCIDENCE: the fix reproducing the defect's own shape. A doctor category with no failure mode inside the remedy for an instrument with no failure mode; a substrate job that could not invoke the gate it was scheduled to run; a duplicated literal inside the de-duplication; a report-level test that hand-built its input; median tests pinning a decision measurement overturned; a coupling test narrower than its premise.

None were careless. Each was correct about the thing it named and blind in the SAME DIMENSION as the original defect — the remedy inherits the author's framing, and the framing is what was wrong. Detection signature is consistent too: a reviewer or a run found every one, never a re-read by me. I am not filing it; the advisor holds TASK-1418 and will know whether it is a third entry beside inert and always-firing.

#1974 is back with you at 0beef8b58a.
subject: #1974 at 0beef8b58a — third marker copy fixed, coupling test now covers the prose, rename mutation goes 3-of-4 red
